messages:
jess: Heads-up — planning a small base-image rebuild to pin glibc to 2.36.x and add an `audit-shipper` sidecar for registry upload events. Want RBAC and KMS questions answered before we cut a canary.

samir: sounds good. what's the immediate risk if we don't rebuild? any active exploits?

lena: CVE triage: CVE-2026-0420 flagged by scanner (libcurl edge case). Not exploited internally, but upstream patch lands in the newer glibc build we want to pin.

jess: correct. This is mostly proactive: fixes + tightening the registry write scope so only the builder service account can push signed layers.

kai: RBAC ask: the current `image-baker` SA has `registry:write` and `keystore:encrypt`. We should split those. Proposal: `image-baker-upload` (write only) + `image-baker-crypt` (kms encrypt/decrypt) with least privilege. Thoughts?

lena: agree. Also add a short-lived binding for the canary run so we can rollback fast.

samir: KMS side: how is the signing key stored? We currently use the project KMS key with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the SA. If we split SA, ensure the `image-baker-crypt` retains that role and nothing else.

jess: plan:
- create `image-baker-upload` (registry write only)
- create `image-baker-crypt` (KMS encrypt/decrypt only)
- update cosign flow to call KMS envelope signing from `image-baker-crypt`
- add `audit-shipper` sidecar that emits registry events to the audit cluster stream (with its own `audit-shipper` SA)

kai: pinging @sec-bot to enumerate required IAM bindings so we don't miss a permission.

sec-bot: IAM diff generated: new SA `image-baker-upload` -> `roles/storage.objectAdmin` (registry bucket write); new SA `image-baker-crypt` -> `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-sign`. Audit shipper SA -> `roles/logging.logWriter` + `roles/pubsub.publisher`.

samir: can we enforce KMS key usage via IAM conditions to only permit encryption calls from the `image-baker-crypt` SA and only from the builder cluster IP range?

lena: yes, add condition `request.auth.principal == 'serviceAccount:image-baker-crypt@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com'` and `resource.name.endsWith('/image-sign')`. Also restrict to `ipSubnet` if supported.

jess: rollout schedule suggestion: canary window Thu Mar 26 01:00-03:00 UTC, small pool (5% builders) with monitoring on: build failures, cosign errors, registry write latency, audit shipper publish errors. If no regressions for 2 hours -> enlarge to 25% for 4 hours -> full.

oncall-sre: I'll add a Grafana dashboard panel for `cosign.sign.errors`, `registry.push.latency`, and `audit-shipper.publish.failures` and attach alert policy: P1 if >5% errors in 5m.

kai: PRs: iam changes -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-4826, cosign update -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-4827, sidecar -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/PR-4828. Please review.

samir: quick note on rollback: we need an escape hatch in the bake pipeline to skip the new signing flow via `BAKER_FLAGS=--skip-sign`. Add that as a gated env toggle in the deployment manifest.

jess: agreed. We'll also tag the canary images with `canary-glibc-2.36` and keep older tag for immediate revert.

lena: vuln triage doc updated: https://dox.internal/redwood/security/cve-2026-0420 (contains the minimal repro, patch link, and test vectors).

jess: runbook snippet for ops (put in the rebuild playbook):
```
# If canary fails
1. Set BAKER_FLAGS=--skip-sign on image-baker deployment
2. Scale image-baker back to previous release (tagged)
3. Revoke temporary IAM binding for canary SAs
4. Open an incident with label `image-rebuild` and ping #incidents
```

kai: commit message for RBAC PR will include the IAM condition, TTL for canary binding, and a link to the runbook.

sec-bot: Audit note: ensure `audit-shipper` includes the registry digest, signer key id, and SA principal in each event. That will be required for downstream compliance proofs.

oncall-sre: quick ops check — the builder cluster nodes need outbound access to KMS. Confirm firewall rule `egress-allow-kms` includes `35.**.*.*` ranges for KMS endpoints. I'll open a short-lived rule change in infra PR if missing.

jess: owners:
- RBAC/IAM: kai (owner)
- KMS wiring & cosign: samir (owner)
- Audit shipper + log schema: lena (owner)
- Monitoring & alerts: oncall-sre (owner)

jess: can everyone review the linked PRs by EOD tomorrow (Mar 25 18:00 UTC)? After approvals I'll schedule the canary slot.

samir: ACK, will do code and manual KMS test today.

lena: ACK, will validate audit payloads against compliance schema and run the CVE test vectors.

kai: ACK, I'll prepare the IAM terraform and the short-lived binding automation.

jess: thanks — I'll update the rebuild ticket with the final canary time once PRs merge. :thumbsup:
